title: Gas prices edge higher into weekend — TTF €32.36, HH $3.24
edito: Storage anxiety meets stratospheric uncertainty. TTF holds €32 as EU inventories slide toward decade lows, while a polar vortex disruption could extend heating season into March. The Merz ETS bombshell adds a volatility layer — but the real story is whether record LNG inflows and weak Asian demand can offset the tightest European storage setup since 2018.
